title: Provenance record
description: Minimal self-contained schema for one protocol fact. Enforced by scripts/validate_provenance.py using only the Python standard library. Version 2 separates where a fact came from (source_state) from whether our implementation has exercised it (verification_state). Those are independent questions and collapsing them into one ladder made it impossible to record a documented fact before the code that would exercise it existed.

ref.description: Pinned tag, commit SHA or document version. Moving branches are rejected.

payload_layout.description: May be documented from a pinned source at any verification_state. Being documented is not being exercised: what the layout means operationally is carried by verification_state, never by the presence of this field.

source_state.description: Where the fact came from. PINNED_SOURCE_RECORDED means it was recorded from an official source tied to a fixed tag or commit, with no claim that it was ever exercised.

verification_state.description: What our implementation has done with the fact. MOCK_EXERCISED tests our own implementation and its internal consistency; it is not independent evidence that the official source is correct. Only HARDWARE_OBSERVED reflects real hardware.

copied_material.description: Must be false. Copied material is prohibited by ADR-0004.

invariants: source.ref must not be a moving branch
a payload_layout may be documented at any verification_state and never implies operational verification
